the initiation factor from rat cytosol that binds to Phe-tRNA is similar to the reticulo-cyte factor IF-M 2 and analogous to the prokaryotic IF-2.
the initiation factor IF-2 is composed of two nonidentical polypeptides that are encoded by separate genes, and that the two polypeptides are present in equimolar amounts in the native factor.

the initiation factor IF-3, which is required to promote the binding of fmet-tRNA and Phe-tRNA, but not Gln-tRNA, to 40 S initiation complexes, can be purified to homogeneity from rabbit reticulocytes.
